checks.name: covered-scope
checks.detail: Removal of non-owned flood-borne debris (stones) from underneath the insured building to the perimeter of the building.

checks.name: excluded-scope
checks.detail: Transportation by barge, handling, disposal, and yard work components outside the building's perimeter footprint.

checks.name: price-support
checks.detail: Additional evidence that the contractor's estimated dollar amount is limited to the covered scope of work; other debris removal estimates from one or more different contractors to verify pricing is reasonable and customary for the location and site conditions.

checks.name: prior-claim-overlap
